prompts.prompt: Original 4 by 4 square portrait atlas for ROOT Network OS, an underground data-center administration game. EXACTLY 16 equal square tiles, edge to edge, NO gutters/borders/text/logos/watermarks. One head-and-shoulders ROBOT in each cell, centered with generous crop margins. No humans, no human skin or biological faces, no existing movie/game robots. Clean sophisticated 2D anime cel-shaded mechanical character illustration, crisp ink lines, charcoal/slate and muted olive/teal metal with small amber or lime or cyan display lights, plain dark slate background and restrained teal/amber rim light. Four rows, four columns. CRITICAL: every robot must have a clearly DIFFERENT silhouette, head geometry, sensor count/placement, screen shape, surface wear and expressive mechanical personality. Some smug, confused, grumpy, sleepy, eager, eccentric, calm or mischievous via display eyes and tilted sensors, not via human face anatomy. Mix old battered industrial units and polished compact models, various shoulder builds, antennas, vents, tiny accessories, but never weapons. Recognizable even as a 64px avatar. Use this specific cast for this sheet without writing any labels: 1 broad olive box head with amber narrow LED slit and huge bolted shoulders, unimpressed; 2 slender tall teal capsule head with one large round cyan camera eye, curious tilt; 3 compact round cream enamel head with two square dot eyes on a black screen, cheerful; 4 old dark rust patched trapezoid head with three mismatched camera lenses, grumpy; 5 black wedge shaped head with bright green pixel smirk on OLED, arrogant; 6 short cylindrical head with rotating stacked sensor rings and sleepy horizontal eyes; 7 tiny yellow forklift style head with two stalk cameras and broad utility shoulders, overexcited; 8 octagonal silver head with violet screen eyes and a bent antenna, confused; 9 red half dome head and single narrow rectangular lens, stern; 10 long rectangular dark blue head with vertical display face, nervous; 11 white triangular head with two recessed red optics, skeptical; 12 olive spherical head with a side dish sensor and cyan diagonal eyes, sly; 13 brass riveted diving bell head with porthole camera, thoughtful; 14 dual separate floating sensor pods connected to a rigid neck chassis, distracted; 15 chunky black CRT monitor head with rounded green screen and goofy asymmetrical eyes; 16 slim steel hexagonal head with visor and small ear cooling fans, calm.
